$comment: Commerce copy added for online checkout. DRAFT for owner review: written to match the v1.1 copy deck's voice. The deck (copy.json) stays verbatim; 'overrides' replaces three deck lines that conflict with buying online.

overrides.imageCaption: Concept image. Pillows, bedside furniture and room styling are not included.
overrides.productionBody: Your bed is made to order in Cape Town. After you pay, we’ll email you to confirm the production time and arrange a delivery date.
overrides.faqProductionAnswer: We make each bed to order in Cape Town. After you pay, we’ll confirm the production time by email and arrange a delivery date with you.

product.notIncluded: Pillows, bedside table and room styling aren’t included.
product.payment: Instant EFT, Capitec Pay or card

faqExtra.question: How do I pay?
faqExtra.answer: Online, through PayFast. You can pay by Instant EFT, Capitec Pay or card. We never see your card or banking details.

faqExtra.question: Where do you deliver?
faqExtra.answer: Delivery is included anywhere in Cape Town. If the bed needs to go further, ask us first and we’ll tell you what’s possible.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.addressIntro: We deliver in Cape Town. We’ll contact you to arrange a day and check the route into your home.

fields.notes: Anything we should know about access? (optional)
fields.notesHint: Stairs, narrow doors, gate codes, complex rules.

checkout.acceptTermsTest: I understand this is a test order. No payment will be taken and no bed will be made.
checkout.payNote: Pay securely on PayFast by Instant EFT, Capitec Pay or card. We never see your card or banking details.
checkout.outOfAreaTitle: We deliver in Cape Town for now.
checkout.outOfAreaBody: That postal code looks like it’s outside our delivery area. Send us an enquiry with your town and we’ll let you know what’s possible.
checkout.startError: We couldn’t start your payment. Nothing has been charged. Please try again in a moment.
checkout.emptyBody: Pick a finish and what you need, then come back here to pay.
checkout.unavailable: Online ordering is paused at the moment. Ask us about the bed and we’ll help you order.

pay.title: Taking you to PayFast…
pay.body: If nothing happens in a few seconds, use the button below.
pay.alreadyPaid: This order has already been paid.

cancelled.seoTitle: Payment not completed | Big Jo’s Beds
cancelled.title: Your payment didn’t go through.
cancelled.body: Nothing was charged. Your selection is saved if you’d like to try again.

order.paidBody: We’ve emailed a confirmation to {email}. We’ll be in touch to confirm the production time and arrange delivery.
order.pendingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. Refresh this page in a moment. If you paid by EFT, it can take a little longer. We’ll email you as soon as it’s confirmed.
order.problemBody: Something about this payment needs a manual check. We’ll contact you by email. You don’t need to pay again.
order.closedBody: Nothing was charged. You can start again whenever you’re ready.
order.notFoundBody: Check the link in your email, or ask us and we’ll look it up.

testShop: Test shop: checkout uses the PayFast sandbox. No real payments are taken and no beds are made.

email.customerIntro: Thanks for your order. Your payment has been received.
